In the midst of a prestigious gardening competition, where the delicate dance of petals and the precise snip of pruning shears were the expected norms, a contestant named Bertrand found himself in a peculiar predicament. Known for his clumsiness with gardening tools, Bertrand had accidentally grabbed a hammer instead of the shears from his toolbox. As he approached his flower arrangement, a beautiful, intricate mix of roses and lilies, he realized his mistake but decided to improvise, thinking, "How different can a hammer be from pruning shears, really?" With a confident, albeit misguided, grin, Bertrand raised the hammer. The first tap of the hammer on the flowers sent the audience into a gasp, with one judge covering her mouth in horror and another judge's eyes widening in disbelief. As Bertrand continued, attempting to "shape" his flower arrangement with the hammer, the scene quickly turned into chaos. Flowers were flying everywhere, petals scattering across the judging table and onto the floor. In the midst of this mayhem, a voice from the audience quipped, "I guess that's one way to prune your chances of winning!" The crowd erupted into laughter, and even the judges couldn't help but chuckle at the absurdity of it all. Bertrand, realizing his mistake, joined in, laughing and holding up his hammer, saying, "I guess I need to work on my delicate touch!"
